svg.title: New FDA listings for bulk BPC-157 powder, by start date
svg.desc: Column chart of current FDA bulk-ingredient listings for BPC-157 by the start date each company reported. 2019–25: 5 listings, 1 labeled for human prescription compounding; Jan: 2 listings, 1 labeled for human prescription compounding; Feb: 0 listings, 0 labeled for human prescription compounding; Mar: 0 listings, 0 labeled for human prescription compounding; Apr: 0 listings, 0 labeled for human prescription compounding; May: 4 listings, 2 labeled for human prescription compounding; Jun: 1 listings, 0 labeled for human prescription compounding; Jul: 6 listings, 2 labeled for human prescription compounding; Aug: 2 listings, 2 labeled for human prescription compounding; Sep: 0 listings, 0 labeled for human prescription compounding; Oct: 0 listings, 0 labeled for human prescription compounding. FDA advisers met on July 23 and 24, 2026; the interim access policy went to the White House on October 14, 2026, cleared review on October 27, and HHS made a draft public on October 28 that lists BPC-157.
